question: 'Slash and burn' agriculture is known as _________ in Mexico and Central America.
solution:
The correct answer is__** Milpa**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• ** Slash and burn agriculture method**:

 
 
• Slash and burn agriculture is a method of** growing food in which wild or forested land is clear cut and any remaining vegetation burned**.
 
• The** layer of ash** after the burning provides the newly-cleared land with a **nutrient-rich layer to help fertilize crops**.
 
• It is also called **shifting cultivation**.
 
• **When the soil fertility decreases, the farmers shift and clear a fresh patch of land for cultivation**.
 
• The ‘slash and burn agriculture is known by different names in different countries as follows:
 
 

 
 

 **Names ** 
 **Countries**
 
 

 Milpa
 Mexico and Central America
 
 

 Conuco
 Venezuela
 
 

 Roca
 Brazil
 
 

 Ladang
 Indonesia
 
 

 Jhoom
 India and Bangladesh
